text: Power: up to 50 points = 50 x the share of hours with the Sun above the terrain.
Earth link: up to 30 points = 30 x the share of hours with the Earth above the terrain.
Continuity: up to 20 points = 20 x (1 - longest darkness / stay). A long blackout costs points.
Knock-out: Earth in view under 25 % of the time, or Sun under 25 %, makes the site NO-GO. It ranks below every valid site.
Verdict: 70+ good, 40+ fair, below 40 poor. Warning if darkness or no Earth link lasts over 48 h.
Ties are broken by more sunlight.
